'''Pzail''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of [[Tantra]] at some point before the [[Galactic War]]. His recording of the declaration of Tantran independence was kept by [[Albathius]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Governor Pzail appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] during the Imperial Agent class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
